answerCheck.reason: For coplanar nonparallel lines an intersection point belongs to both sets, so their minimum point-pair distance is 0. Their point-to-line distance varies, so they lack a common positive uniform separation. In space, l={(t,0,0)} and m={(0,s,1)} are nonparallel skew lines with minimum distance 1. The stem does not specify either the ambient dimension or the intended distance convention, so its yes/no wording has no unique general reading.
